name: 01_config_env_without_export
why: THE incident. Between 2026-07-18 and 2026-07-30 the env file lost its `export` lines, the hook sourced it into a SHELL variable the child process never inherited, and the binary read an empty os.Getenv: 743 hook runs, 743 skips, exit 0, empty stderr. Both implementations must now read the FILE themselves, so a file with no `export` still yields the key.
on_failure: The plugin whose api_key_source is not `file` is back to depending on shell semantics — it will go silent again exactly like 2026-07-18. Fix the loader (Go: core/envfile.go loadEnvFileInto; Python: hermes-agent/config.py read_env_file) so a bare KEY=VALUE line is honoured.
